activity.notes: Mem de Sá was the third governor-general of the Portuguese State of Brazil. Brazilian archival and historical references place his administration in 1558-1572; office lists give 3 January 1558 as his assumption of office and he governed until his death in Salvador on 2 March 1572. Retry v2 normalizes the role string to the canonical ATLAS role label 'Governor General' after the v1 Production write succeeded but the workflow read-back comparator rejected the hyphenated authoring label.
